installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

# =========================================================
# Nimauria Hosting - Uptime Kuma Installer
# =========================================================
# Repository:
# https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma
#
# This installer is designed for:
# - Pterodactyl Panel
# - Wings
# - Node.js 20+
# - Debian-based installer containers
#
# Features:
# - Safe Git updates
# - Existing install detection
# - Persistent data directory handling
# - Node.js version validation
# - Better logging and failure handling
# - Cleaner production deployment flow
# =========================================================

echo "========================================================="
echo "          Nimauria Hosting - Uptime Kuma"
echo "========================================================="
echo "Starting installation process..."
echo "Container: $(hostname)"
echo "Install Time: $(date)"
echo "========================================================="

SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
DEFAULT_REPO="https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 1 - PREPARE SERVER DIRECTORY
# ---------------------------------------------------------

echo ""
echo "[1/8] Preparing server directory..."
mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}"
cd "${SERVER_DIR}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 2 - UPDATE INSTALLER PACKAGES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

echo ""
echo "[2/8] Updating installer packages..."

apt update

apt install -y \
    git \
    curl \
    ca-certificates \
    python3 \
    make \
    g++ \
    build-essential

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 3 - VALIDATE REQUIRED TOOLS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

echo ""
echo "[3/8] Validating runtime environment..."
echo "Installing Node.js 22..."
curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash -
apt install -y nodejs
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    echo "ERROR: Node.js is missing from the installer container."
    exit 1
}

command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    echo "ERROR: npm is missing from the installer container."
    exit 1
}

command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    echo "ERROR: git is missing from the installer container."
    exit 1
}

NODE_MAJOR="$(node -v | sed 's/v//' | cut -d. -f1)"

if [ "${NODE_MAJOR}" -lt 20 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Node.js 20 or newer is required."
    echo "Current version: $(node -v)"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Node Version: $(node -v)"
echo "NPM Version: $(npm -v)"
echo "Git Version: $(git --version)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 4 - PREPARE GIT REPOSITORY
# ---------------------------------------------------------

echo ""
echo "[4/8] Preparing Git repository..."

REPO="${GIT_ADDRESS:-$DEFAULT_REPO}"

git config --global --add safe.directory "${SERVER_DIR}"

echo "Repository: ${REPO}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5 - INSTALL OR UPDATE
# ---------------------------------------------------------

echo ""
echo "[5/8] Installing or updating Uptime Kuma..."

if [ -d ".git" ]; then

    echo "Existing installation detected."
    echo "Updating existing repository..."

    git remote set-url origin "${REPO}"

    git fetch --all --prune

    git pull --ff-only || {
        echo ""
        echo "ERROR: Git fast-forward update failed."
        echo "Local changes may exist in the container."
        echo "Installation aborted to prevent corruption."
        exit 1
    }

else

    echo "No existing installation detected."
    echo "Performing fresh installation..."

    if [ "$(find "${SERVER_DIR}" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 | wc -l)" -gt 0 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "ERROR: Server directory is not empty."
        echo "Please use a clean installation directory."
        exit 1
    fi

    git clone "${REPO}" .
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 6 - PREPARE DATA DIRECTORY
# ---------------------------------------------------------

echo ""
echo "[6/8] Preparing persistent data directory..."

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/data"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 7 - INSTALL DEPENDENCIES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

echo ""
echo "[7/8] Installing Uptime Kuma dependencies..."

npm run setup

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 8 - VERIFY INSTALLATION
# ---------------------------------------------------------

echo ""
echo "[8/8] Verifying installation..."

if [ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/server/server.js" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "ERROR: server/server.js was not found."
    echo "The installation appears incomplete."
    exit 1
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# COMPLETE
# ---------------------------------------------------------

echo ""
echo "========================================================="
echo "      Nimauria Hosting - Installation Complete"
echo "========================================================="
echo "Application: Uptime Kuma"
echo "Repository : ${REPO}"
echo "Install Dir: ${SERVER_DIR}"
echo "Data Dir   : ${SERVER_DIR}/data"
echo "Node.js    : $(node -v)"
echo "Timezone   : ${TZ:-Not Set}"
echo "========================================================="
echo "Uptime Kuma has been installed successfully."
echo "========================================================="

exit 0
